# PeptideRecon

> > Independent peptide supplier intelligence hub providing HPLC-verified quality data, supplier rankings, and comprehensive peptide profiles across healing, performance, longevity, and cognitive enhancement categories.

PeptideRecon serves as a centralized intelligence platform for peptide sourcing and procurement, offering detailed supplier comparisons, quality testing methodologies, and safety compliance guides. The site aggregates data on 40+ suppliers ranging from pharmaceutical-grade manufacturers like Bachem and GenScript to research-grade providers and licensed compounding pharmacies.

## Key Topics

- HPLC Testing & Quality Verification
- GMP Certification & Compliance
- Supplier Intelligence & Rankings
- BPC-157 & Healing Peptides
- Performance Enhancement Peptides
- Longevity & Anti-Aging Compounds
- Cognitive Enhancement (Semax, Selank)
- Metabolic & Weight Management
- Procurement Strategy
- Vendor Due Diligence
- Pharmaceutical vs Research Grade
- COA Verification Methods
- Supplier Comparison Matrix
- Compounding Pharmacy Intelligence
- Peptide Sourcing & Logistics

## Supplier Intelligence

- [Peptide Supplier Intelligence Hub](https://peptiderecon.com/suppliers): Main supplier intelligence hub with HPLC testing and purity verification data
- [Top 10 Peptide Suppliers 2025 - Intelligence Rankings](https://peptiderecon.com/suppliers/top-10-suppliers.html): Rankings of top suppliers including Bachem, GenScript, and Oath Peptides
- [Complete Supplier Comparison Matrix - 40 Supplier Analysis](https://peptiderecon.com/suppliers/comparison-matrix.html): Comprehensive 40-supplier comparison matrix with GMP compliance analysis
- [Peptide Supplier Comparisons](https://peptiderecon.com/suppliers/comparisons): Head-to-head supplier comparison guides with pricing and quality metrics
- [Pharmaceutical Grade Peptide Suppliers](https://peptiderecon.com/suppliers/pharmaceutical): GMP-certified pharmaceutical suppliers: Bachem, GenScript, WuXi AppTec
- [Research Grade Peptide Suppliers](https://peptiderecon.com/suppliers/research): Directory of research-grade suppliers: Peptide Sciences, Pure Rawz, Swiss Chems
- [Compounding Pharmacy Peptide Suppliers](https://peptiderecon.com/suppliers/pharmacy): Licensed compounding pharmacies: Empower, Hallandale, Tailor Made

## Peptide Database & Profiles

- [Peptide Database](https://peptiderecon.com/peptides): Comprehensive peptide database covering healing, performance, longevity categories
- [Healing & Recovery Peptides](https://peptiderecon.com/peptides/healing): Healing peptides intelligence: BPC-157, TB-500, GHK-Cu with supplier guides
- [Performance Enhancement Peptides](https://peptiderecon.com/peptides/performance): Performance peptides: Ipamorelin, CJC-1295, IGF-1 LR3 with research data
- [Longevity & Anti-Aging Peptides](https://peptiderecon.com/peptides/longevity): Anti-aging peptides: Epithalon, Thymosin Alpha-1, Pinealon profiles
- [Cognitive Enhancement Peptides](https://peptiderecon.com/peptides/cognitive): Cognitive peptides: Semax, Selank, NSI-189 with nootropic research data
- [Metabolic & Weight Management Peptides](https://peptiderecon.com/peptides/metabolic): Metabolic peptides: Semaglutide, Tirzepatide, GLP-1 agonists intelligence
- [Specialty Peptides](https://peptiderecon.com/peptides/specialty): Specialty peptides: DSIP, cosmetic compounds, experimental research molecules

- [Safety & Compliance Guides](https://peptiderecon.com/guides/safety): Safety guides: supplier vetting, red flags, fraud prevention, due diligence
- [Procurement Guides](https://peptiderecon.com/guides/procurement): Procurement strategy guides: vendor selection, GMP certification, logistics
